about:
# Negative Hitboxes
Makes every single object's hitbox <cr>negative</c>. <cg>[Geo was very happy.](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/8MLZE3eXRuQ)</c>

## What does it do?
This mod <cr>inverts</c> the scale of each object and also disables the level's <cy>"Fix Negative Scale"</c> option.

In other words, turns it into [one of those videos](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/CM_Tp2ktyiE).

## Why?
Because.

## But is it even possible?
Depends on the level, really.

## What's "Enable Voicelines"?
It's a setting that plays a <cg>random</c> audio clip when you enter a level. Most of the clips are from <cy>Geo's</c> videos, so credit to him.

## Why does Safe Mode exist?
Some levels become easier, which is technically <cr>cheating</c>. You can turn it off in settings, though.
changelog:
# 1.7.0
- Added a setting to disable the Safe Mode warning.

# 1.6.0
- Added Safe Mode warning before entering "The Challenge"
- Improved the wording of the "Enable" toggle description in the Eclipse tab.

# 1.5.1
- Fixed voicelines playing when the mod isn't enabled.

# 1.5.0
- Added the ability to disable the mod back.
- Added more toggles in the Eclipse tab.

# 1.4.0
- Removed the ability to disable the mod through the mod's settings. Use <cy>Geode's</c> toggle instead.
- Added two new voicelines.
- Added Eclipse integration.
- Fixed voicelines from sometimes playing twice.
- Changed the mod icon.

# 1.3.1
- Added `GameObjectType::SpiderOrb` and `GameObjectType::TeleportOrb` to ignored orbs list.
- Fixed cross-platform path handling.

# 1.3.0
- Fixed attempts from going negative. Yes this was a real bug.
- Added Safe Mode warning on The Tower level doors.
- Added some voicelines for when you enter a level.

# 1.2.1
- Fixed being able to bypass the Safe Mode popup by clicking "No" and playing anyway.

# 1.2.0
- Added "Safe Mode"

# 1.1.0
- Added options to ignore pads, portals and orbs.

# 1.0.1
- Removed the "Hide Visual Scale" option due to it doing literally nothing.
- Removed "Node IDs" dependency.

# 1.0.0
- Initial release.
